collections_window_ordered.name: collections_window_ordered
collections_window_ordered.value: "collections"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "collections"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "collections"."ends_at" > "collections"."starts_at"

product_variants_one_default_uq.name: product_variants_one_default_uq
product_variants_one_default_uq.where: is_default = true AND deleted_at IS NULL

generated.as:
setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(name, '')), 'A') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(sku, '')), 'A') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(short_description, '')), 'B') ||
        setweight(to_tsvector('english', coalesce(description, '')), 'C')

products_pricing_coherent.name: products_pricing_coherent
products_pricing_coherent.value:
("products"."pricing_mode" = 'FIXED' AND "products"."selling_price_paise" IS NOT NULL AND "products"."selling_price_paise" > 0)
       OR ("products"."pricing_mode" = 'METAL_RATE' AND "products"."net_metal_weight_mg" > 0)

products_mrp_above_selling.name: products_mrp_above_selling
products_mrp_above_selling.value: "products"."mrp_paise" IS NULL OR "products"."selling_price_paise" IS NULL OR "products"."mrp_paise" > "products"."selling_price_paise"

product_attributes_exactly_one_value.name: product_attributes_exactly_one_value
product_attributes_exactly_one_value.value:
(CASE WHEN "product_attributes"."value_text" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "product_attributes"."value_number" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
        + (CASE WHEN "product_attributes"."value_boolean" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
